name: Dyersburg State Community College
tuition_note: In-state tuition & fees $5,084/yr (full-time, Fall+Spring), 2026-27, from official DSCC Cost of Attendance PDF (DSCC-COA-26-27.pdf) linked at dscc.edu/understanding-costs-payments. Out-of-state is $8,564/yr. Housing: null because the COA PDF (Living Expenses page) explicitly states 'The institution does not have on-campus housing'; the $10,850 room+board figure shown is a College Board national-average commuter estimate for financial-aid budgeting, not an actual on-campus housing charge.
